I will not put chemical fertilizer on this plot because it is rented and one bag costs more money than I have in my hands. I will carry sheep manure from our compound and spread it the way my mother always did, since it does not cost naira. I will plant the maize seed I saved from last year's harvest because I have seen it grow and I do not trust the new seeds they sell in town. My children and I will do all the work ourselves, about forty-two days from clearing to harvest, because I have no cash to pay hired workers.
